Body.Content:
We are expanding the regional availability of Azure IoT Suite to include Australia and Japan, as well as Microsoft Azure Deutschland (preview), a Microsoft cloud with German data trustee T-Systems.

The IoT Suite provisioning sites (https://www.azureiotsuite.com and https://www.azureiotsuite.de), along with both preconfigured solutions, support German, Japanese, and 14 other languages.

For more information, take a look at the Remote Monitoring v1.3.0 release notes and the Predictive Maintenance v1.1.0 release notes.
